summary: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp. (DMAA), a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement with Power Analytics Global Corp (PAGC), a Delaware AI/analytics/security firm. The merger values PAGC at $1.0 billion target enterprise value, subject to a valuation milestone schedule based on delivered revenue contracts, with a $300 million floor. Post-closing ownership is expected to be ~90% former PAGC shareholders and ~10% existing DMAA shareholders, prior to any PIPE. The transaction will be structured as a reverse merger, with PAGC merging into DMAA, and the surviving entity listing on Nasdaq. Closing is subject to SEC registration statement effectiveness, shareholder approval, and other conditions. Watch for the registration statement filing and PIPE details; risk-arb involves valuation uncertainty and deal renegotiation risk at the floor.
